nodes.label: Invoke eth_sendTransactionToContractFunction
nodes.description: DApp calls the new RPC method with transaction object and ABI parameter

nodes.label: Wallet Received Transaction Request
nodes.description: Wallet/provider has received the RPC request with function ABI

nodes.label: Validate ABI Matches Data
nodes.description: Verify ABI-derived function signature hash matches truncated keccak256 of data field

nodes.description: Function selector from ABI matches the transaction data prefix

nodes.label: ABI Mismatch Detected
nodes.description: Function selector does not match - potential spoofing attempt

nodes.label: Display Human-Readable Confirmation
nodes.description: Show user the decoded function name, parameters, and values from ABI

nodes.label: Awaiting User Approval

sub_graphs.title: EIP-2566: ABI-Data Signature Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation process ensuring ABI matches transaction data

nodes.label: ABI Parameter Received

nodes.label: Parse Function ABI
nodes.description: Extract function name and parameter types from ABI JSON

nodes.description: Calculate keccak256 hash of function signature and take first 4 bytes

nodes.description: Extract first 4 bytes of transaction data field

nodes.label: Compare Function Selectors
nodes.description: Compare ABI-derived selector with data field selector

nodes.label: Selectors Match
nodes.description: ABI function selector matches transaction data - ABI is valid for this transaction

nodes.label: Selectors Do Not Match

nodes.description: Render function name and parameters to user based on provided ABI

nodes.description: User sees human-readable function information derived from ABI

nodes.label: User Makes Trust Decision

external_entities.name: Decentralized Application
external_entities.description: Potentially malicious DApp that provides ABI metadata

ambiguities.text: No specification for what happens when ABI validation fails (selector mismatch)
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume wallet should reject the RPC request and return an error, or display a warning to the user about the mismatch.

ambiguities.text: The specification says displaying function details 'is not a guarantee that a function will execute as the user expects'
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this means the ABI could be for a different contract with the same function signature, or the contract could behave differently than the ABI suggests.

ambiguities.text: No specification for handling ABI parsing errors or malformed ABI JSON
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume wallet should reject requests with invalid ABI JSON and return an appropriate error code.

implicit_assumptions.description: Users understand that the displayed function information comes from the DApp, not from verifying the actual contract code
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users may approve transactions believing the displayed function is accurate when the contract could execute entirely different logic

implicit_assumptions.description: The ABI provided by the DApp accurately represents the contract function being called
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Function selector collision attacks possible - different function with same 4-byte selector could be displayed misleadingly

implicit_assumptions.description: Wallets implementing this EIP will properly validate the ABI-to-data signature match
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Wallets could display arbitrary function information unrelated to the actual transaction, enabling phishing attacks
